remarks: Location! Welcome to an exquisite sanctuary nestled in the coveted Westover area. This stunning residence promises an elegant lifestyle with its modern touches and serene surroundings. Boasting 4 bedrooms/3.5 bathrooms this property offers a harmonious blend of sophistication and comfort. Upon entering, you'll be captivated by the chef's dream kitchen, featuring high-end appliances including a Viking gas stove, Sub-Zero refrigerator, dual wall ovens, and a substantial kitchen island, perfect for culinary creations and gathering w/ friends. The open flow leads seamlessly to spacious living room adorned w/ a cozy fireplace, creating an inviting ambiance for entertaining or relaxing. The main level also showcases a formal dining room and a sunroom with large windows, inviting an abundance of natural light and offering picturesque views of the tranquil outdoors. This floor accommodates a convenient bedroom and full bathroom, a harmonious blend of privacy and practicality. Ascend to the upper level and discover the luxurious primary suite, w/walk-in closet/oversized bathroom featuring a dual vanity, jacuzzi tub, walk in shower. An additional bedroom on this floor offers a beautiful ensuite bath/walk-in closet. To enhance convenience, a second-floor laundry room ensures ease in completing household tasks. Partially finished basement, offering versatile spaces home office/gym/playroom. Serene level lot is perfect for summer nights! Located near train station/restaurants/shops.
